description: Our goal is to make learning easy and fun.
summary: Natural Satellite Explorer is an interactive educational application designed to make learning about natural satellites in the Solar System more accessible and engaging. It addresses the challenge of presenting complex astronomical information in a simple and understandable way. Users can explore six natural satellites — the Moon, Europa, Io, Ganymede, Titan, and Enceladus — learn about their scientific characteristics, compare their features, and test their knowledge through quizzes and true-or-false activities. By combining scientific information with interactive learning, our project encourages curiosity about astronomy, improves research and comparison skills, and makes space science more engaging for students and other learners.
details:
What Does Our Project Do?

Natural Satellite Explorer is an interactive educational application that allows users to discover and learn about natural satellites in the Solar System.

Users can select different natural satellites and explore their scientific characteristics, including mass, temperature, gravity, atmosphere, and orbital period. The application also provides a comparison feature that helps users understand the similarities and differences between satellites.

To make learning more engaging, the application includes quizzes and true-or-false activities.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Our project aims to make astronomical information easier to understand and more accessible, especially for students and people interested in space science.

Its main benefits include:

- Encouraging interest in astronomy and space exploration.

- Making scientific information easier to learn.

- Supporting interactive and independent learning.

- Improving observation, research, and comparison skills.

- Helping users understand the diversity of natural satellites.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of our project is the combination of scientific exploration, comparison, and educational activities in one interactive application. Instead of simply reading information, users actively explore different satellites and test what they have learned.

Development Tools and Technologies

The application was developed using the Rosebud platform. The platform was used to create the interactive application and its user experience.

Team: Duru Ersoy and Zeynep Duru Gül

Project type: Educational and Interactive Science Application
